title: Christmas Bake Sale
summary: Holiday treats all week to power you through finals. Swing by the MULC table and say hi!
description: End the semester with MULC's Christmas Bake Sale. As finals season creeps up, lean into the holiday spirit and treat yourself. We'll be at SAMU every day from November 23 to 27, 10 AM to 4 PM. Members looking for volunteer hours can sign up as bakers or station workers through the forms linked in our Instagram bio.

title: MULC x Barr LLP Shadow Program
summary: Spend a day shadowing lawyers at Barr LLP and see what legal practice really looks like.
description: The MULC x Barr LLP Shadow Program gives students firsthand exposure to legal practice at Barr LLP. Participants shadow lawyers in a professional setting, observe day-to-day legal work, and learn about different practice areas through direct interaction with practitioners. It's designed to help you explore career paths in law, build professional connections, and better understand the realities of legal practice. Sign up with the RSVP button.
